title: Fish of the Day
description: Grilled fresh fish fillet with a light lemon and white wine cream sauce. Simply done and always changing.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Season fish fillets with salt. Melt half the butter in a pan and brush over the fish. Grill under a hot grill for 3–4 minutes per side until just cooked through and the flesh flakes easily.
For the sauce: add remaining butter to a small saucepan over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 2–3 minutes.
Deglaze with white wine and reduce by half, about 1–2 minutes.
Add thickened cream and lemon juice. Stir and reduce for 2–3 minutes until the sauce is light and coats the back of a spoon. Season with salt.
Stir in fresh parsley just before serving. Plate the fish and spoon the lemon cream sauce over the top.

notes.title: Light Sauce
notes.content: No demi glace is used — this is a light cream, wine and lemon sauce designed to complement rather than overpower the fish. The fish variety changes with market availability, but the sauce and method remain the same.
